newsitem.title: USA: Twinlab Q3 net income with charge $2.2 mln.
newsitem.headline: Twinlab Q3 net income with charge $2.2 mln.

text.p: NOTE: Net income for the 1996 nine months reflects a $15.3 million non-recurring charge for the write-off of certain non- competition agreements, $400,000 of non-recurring transaction expenses and a $6.3 million increase in interest expense, all resulting from company's recapitalization in May.
Net income for the 1996 third quarter includes a $4.1 million increase in interest expense from recapitalization.
Net income for the nine-months and the quarter reflects income tax increase from the company's conversion from "S" corporation to "C" corporation status.
The company has filed for an initial public offering of 8.5 million shares.
